Commentary.Commentary: Welcome back everyone for Ireland's reply. The Bangladesh players stride out and take the field. Followed by Paul Stirling and Stephen Doheny who walk out to open for Ireland. It will be Mustafizur Rahman to start with the new ball.
... The Run Chase ...

So then, the track is supportive to batters as we have seen so far and let us not forgot that there will be dew at some point in the second innings. So an enticing chase is coming your way, do join us shortly for the second essay...

For Ireland, the bowlers were on top in the initial stage but they failed to capitalize on the nervy start from the hosts and that big 4th wicket partnership is the main reason behind this mammoth total that they have been asked to chase down. Graham Hume was the stand-out bowler with his four-wicket haul, while Mark Adair, Curtis Campher and Andy McBrine took a wicket each.

Bangladesh started off a bit sluggish as they lost the top-order for not many runs on the board but a brilliant partnership of 135 between the debutant, Towhid Hridoy and the experienced, Shakib Al Hasan helped them to stable the ship and laid down a perfect platform for the rest of the pack. Shakib Al Hasan just missed out on his century while the debutant, Hridoy also slipped out in his 90s. Mushfiqur Rahim  played an amazing cameo right at the end as he scored 44 runs in no time at all. A flurry of wickets in the later stages pulled back things a fair bit for Ireland, but the damage had already been done. Bangladesh end with a competitive total on the board.

This has been a dominating effort with the bat by the home side. The way it started it looked like Bangladesh would get anywhere near the 300-run mark but their batters have done really well here to get them out of trouble. Ireland now have a stiff challenge on their hands.
BYE! Full length, on off. Rahman swings but misses. The batters cross for a bye. Bangladesh end their innings at 338/8.
Fuller, on off, pushed to covers for a single.
FOUR! Back of a length, on off. Ahmed tries to pull it away. The ball though flies down to fine leg off the top edge. Four runs.
A single now as this is pushed out to the off side.

OUT! RUN OUT! It is full and on middle. Ali slogs it to deep mid-wicket. He runs the first one hard and calls for the second run. Curtis Campher throws it to the keeper. Lorcan Tucker is quick to dislodge the bails. The square leg umpire raises his finger instantly, as he is certain that Yasir Ali is way short of the crease.
SIX! BANG! Just the start Bangladesh were looking for in the final over. It is a good-length ball, outside off. Yasir Ali frees his arms and smokes it over the cover fence.
FOUR! A freebie and Nasum Ahmed gleefully accepts it. It is a full toss, on off. Nasum Ahmed goes back and swats it towards cow corner. It is hit in the gap and goes over the ropes.
Adair fires in a yorker, in the blockhole. Yasir Ali digs it out late, towards backward point. One taken.
FOUR! A much-needed boundary. It is very full, outside off. Ali throws his bat at it. The ball takes the outer half and runs down to third man.
Slower one, full and on off. Ahmed pushes it to mid off and rotates the strike.
Yorker length, outside off. Ahmed looks to heave it across the line but misses.
Short, on off. Ali pulls it to deep mid-wicket with no timing at all. They only get a single. Ali off the strike now.
Fuller, outside off. Nasum Ahmed swings hard at it but gets no where near the ball.
LEG BYE! Very full, down leg. Ali fails to flick it away. The ball goes to short fine off the pads. They cross for a leg bye.
A single now as this length ball is pushed to point.
Nasum Ahmed walks out next.

OUT! CAUGHT! Graham Hume picks up his fourth wicket. It is a short ball, on off. Taskin Ahmed goes for the pull shot but he does not middle it. Mark Adair comes in from the deep and takes an easy catch. Bangladesh are getting derailed at the back end of the innings.
Commentary.Howout: c Mark Adair b Graham Hume

Commentary.Commentary: Yorker length, outside off. Ali digs it out towards long off. One taken.
A low full toss, on off. Ahmed smacks it down to long off, only for a single.
Length, outside off. Ahmed pushes it to point for one.
A full toss, on off. Taskin Ahmed pulls it towards deep mid-wicket. He does not hit it cleanly and the ball lands safely. The fielder though fumbles which allows the batters to take a couple.
SIX! BOOM! Taskin Ahmed making his intent clear. It is a slower ball, full and on off. Taskin Ahmed gets down on one knee and slogs it powerfully over the mid-wicket fence.
Fuller, on off. Ali goes for an expansive shot through the line. He gets an inside edge on his pads. One taken.
Yorker length, in the blockhole. Taskin Ahmed negotiates well this time, as he tucks it to the leg side for a single.
A single now as Yasir Ali pushes this full one into covers.
Swing and a miss! A dot ball to end a successful over form Hume. Good length, outside off. Ahmed looks to chase it but misses.
Taskin Ahmed walks out next.

OUT! TIMBER! Graham Hume goes BANG, BANG! Two huge wickets in this over and Bangladesh lose both their set batters in a jiffy. A peach of a delivery though quite unplayable. Graham Hume fires in a full delivery, swinging in. Towhid Hridoy is caught inside the crease, he tries to flick it away but ends up playing all around it. The ball goes through to rattle the stumps.
Good length, outside off. Ali chops it through covers for a single.
Yasir Ali is the next batter.

OUT! CAUGHT! Graham Hume strikes right on cue for his team. Ireland needed this wicket desparately. It is a short ball, on the bodyline. Mushfiqur Rahim is cramped for room here. He goes for the pull shot but only catches the outside edge. The ball lobs to short fine leg and Andy McBrine there takes an easy catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Andy McBrine b Graham Hume

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Up and over! Hume goes full, wide outside off. Mushfiqur Rahim gets down on one knee and hits it over extra covers. One bounce and over the ropes.
Full length, outside off. Towhid Hridoy drives it to extra cover and scampers across for a quick single.
Graham Hume ( 7-0-38-1) replaces Mark Adair.
Back of a length, on off. Towhid Hridoy pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single. 10 runs off the over. Towhid Hridoy moves to 91.

FOUR! Edgy! Luck goes Towhid Hridoy's way once again. It is a pace-up delivery, short and outside off. Towhid Hridoy goes for the tennis shot, like a forehand smash but it catches the inside edge. The ball races down to third man and into the fence.
Slower ball this time, on a good length. Mushfiqur Rahim slogs it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
It is full and on off. Rahi shuffles and goes for the scoop shot. He misses it.
Length and on off, defended.
FOUR! Incredible shot. Curtis Campher fires in a yorker-length delivery, outside off. Mushfiqur Rahim waits for it and smacks it over covers for four runs.
Short ball, wide of off. Rahim shuffles and cuts it over point for just a single this time.
Length and on off. Towhid Hridoy pushes it out for a single.
FOUR! What a shot! Mark Adair digs in a short ball, outside off. Towhid Hridoy rides the bounce and cuts it powerfully through point for four runs.

A full toss, on the body. Towhid Hridoy drags his pull towards square leg. The batters are quick between the wickets and they collect two with ease. Some questions are asked for run out as there is a direct hit at the non-striker's end. The third umpire confirms that it it not out.
Adair goes full, outside off. Towhid Hridoy tries to smack it through the line but without moving his feet. He gets beaten on the outside edge this time.
Back of a length, on off. Mushfiqur Rahim pulls it to deep square leg for a one run.
Full and on leg. Mushfiqur Rahim sweeps it down to fine leg for a single.
Very full, on off. Hridoy crunches it towards mid off. The fielder there makes a sharp stop. One taken.

SIX! Just over! Towhid Hridoy continues to ride his luck in this innings. It is a length ball, on off. Towhid Hridoy pulls it hard and flat towards deep square leg. He does not middle it, in face it comes off the toe end. The ball though has enough it in to beat the leaping fielder near the ropes.

Fuller and on leg. Rahim goes outside leg and plays it inside out. It goes aerially to the left of the bowler. Gareth Delany dives to that side but only manages to get a hand on it. Misses a huge opportunity here.
SIX! BANG! Mushfiqur Rahim is on fire. It is full and on off. Mushfiqur Rahim gets low and slogs it towards deep mid-wicket. He gets enough power on it to beat the fielder in the deep.
Back of a length, outside off. Towhid Hridoy cuts it to deep point for just a single.
Back of a length, on off. Towhid Hridoy rides the bounce and pulls it powerfully through mid-wicket. There is protection in the deep, they only get a single.
Length ball, sliding down leg. Rahim works it down to fine leg and makes it to the other end.
FOUR! Mushfiqur Rahim finds the boundary this time. It is full, around off. Rahim goes back a touch and smacks it over point for a cracking boundary.
A well-directed short ball, on middle. Mushfiqur Rahim tries to hook it away but misses.
The cheers get louder now as 250 comes up for Bangladesh. Short and outside off. Towhid Hridoy cuts it to deep point for one.
Back of a length, on off. Rahim dabs it down to third man and crosses.
Full and on off. Rahim shuffles, gets low and goes for the scoop shot. It goes towards fine leg after hitting his shoulders on its way. One taken. A good over from Delany here.
Towhid Hridoy moves down leg, Gareth Delany follows the batter with a full one. Towhid Hridoy drills it down to long on for one.
Flatter, outside off. Rahim punches it through covers for another single.
Shorter, outside off. Hridoy cuts it over point for another one.
Fuller, angled into the pads. Rahim flicks it into mid-wicket for a single.
Short, wide of off. Towhid Hridoy cuts it through point for one.
Time for Powerplay 3! Now 5 fielders can be placed outside the inner circle until the end of the innings.

SIX! This has been hit way over the fence by the experienced Mushfiqur Rahim. Fuller outside off, Mushfiqur Rahim gives this a full flow of his bat and lofts this well over the fence straight down the ground.
Good length delivery outside off, Towhid Hridoy cuts this to point for a single.
On a length around off, Mushfiqur Rahim taps this wide of point for a single.
Back of a length outside off, Towhid Hridoy smashes this to sweeper cover for a single.
On a length wide of off, Towhid Hridoy leaves this expecting a wide but the umpire calls it a fair delivery.
Short and wide of off, Towhid Hridoy punches this to short cover.
Half-tracker in middle, Towhid Hridoy pulls this flat and powerfully for a single towards deep mid-wicket.
Tossed up on off, Mushfiqur Rahim pushes this to sweeper cover for a single.
Short in length around middle, Towhid Hridoy pushes this to long on for a single.
Fuller on off, Mushfiqur Rahim reverse sweeps this but the fielder at short third man does well to get a hand on this and keep it down to a single.
SIX! This has sailed over the fielder for a maximum. Tossed up around off, Mushfiqur Rahim slogs this over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
Fuller and quicker, Mushfiqur Rahim defends this out.
SIX! A cracking stroke to gain a maximum. On a length around middle, Towhid Hridoy plays the short arm jab and finds the meat of his bat to smash this for a maximum straight down the ground.
On a length around middle, Towhid Hridoy punches this back towards the bowler.
Back of a length outside off, Mushfiqur Rahim punches this off the back foot for a single towards sweeper cover.
On a length outside off, Mushfiqur Rahim taps this to point for no run.
Mushfiqur Rahim is the new batter in.

OUT! TAKEN! Too full and wide of off, Shakib Al Hasan goes searching for this and he has edged this into the hands of the Lorcan Tucker for his dismissal. Shakib Al Hasan misses out on his century here.
Commentary.Howout: c Lorcan Tucker b Graham Hume

Commentary.Commentary: On a length outside off, Shakib Al Hasan pulls this to mid on for no run.
Length dragged back on off, Shakib Al Hasan smashes this to sweeper cover for a single.
Fuller one wide of off, Towhid Hridoy pushes this to sweeper cover for a single.
On a length wide of off, Shakib Al Hasan cuts this to backward point for a single.
Quicker one on middle, Towhid Hridoy lofts this over mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Towhid Hridoy leaves this for the keeper to collect.
Tossed up wide of off, Shakib Al Hasan stretches and smashes this to long off for a single.
On a length outside off, Towhid Hridoy looks to slog but misses out.
FOUR! Towhid Hridoy is bringing the crowd alive here. Short-pitched delivery around the waist, Towhid Hridoy pulls this like a rocket for a boundary towards deep mid-wicket.
Fuller around off, Towhid Hridoy looks to play across the line and misses out.
On a length around off, Shakib Al Hasan smashes this to long off for a single. Brilliant fielding in the deep.
Back of a length outside off, Shakib Al Hasan cuts this to point.

FIFTY for Hridoy on his debut! This is what dreams are made of. Although he would feel that the job is still half done here. Fuller outside off, Towhid Hridoy drives this to deep extra cover for a single.

FOUR! Shakib Al Hasan racks up 22 runs off this over. Also, Bangladesh cross the 200-run mark. It is floated and full, on off. Shakib Al Hasan lofts it over the bowler's head and gets a boundary at long off.

FOUR! Shakib Al Hasan has the crowd on its feet here. They are dancing as well, while Harry Tector is unable to make Shakib Al Hasan dance on his tunes here. Shakib Al Hasan is loving this battle with Harry Tector, and is dominating it as well. It is flatter, outside off. Shakib Al Hasan rocks back and cuts it past backward point for a cracking boundary.

IN THE AIR...Safe! Shakib Al Hasan has some ladyluck on his side now. It is full and on off. Shakib Al Hasan tries to slog it away but it comes off the outside edge. The ball goes very high in the air towards long on. Mark Adair has to give it a long chase from mid on and does not get there in time. The ball lands safely and they take a couple.

FOUR! Three on the trot! Shakib Al Hasan is turning on the heat here and well, the crowd is getting into the act as well. Floated and full, on off. Shakib Al Hasan gets low and sweeps it through square leg for four more. The runs are coming in thick and fast here.
FOUR! Consecutive boundaries. Shakib Al Hasan is in the groove. It is a full one, on off. Shakib Al Hasan makes some room and carves it through covers for four runs.
FOUR! Shakib Al Hasan is finding the boundaries at will. It is full and on off. Shakib Al Hasan gets low and sweeps it behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
Much fuller, on off. Hridoy dabs it out towards point. He denies the single straightaway as he hits it straight to the fielder.
Short and on off. Shakib Al Hasan helps it into the off side for a single.
Good length, on leg stump. Shakib Al Hasan swivels and swats it past backward square leg. The batters take two before the fielder cuts it out.
A length ball, outside off. Towhid Hridoy throws the bat at it. The ball sneaks past the stump as it takes the inside edge. Towhid Hridoy riding his luck here. They cross for one.
Good length, angled across, in the channel. Shakib Al Hasan plays it late and guides it down to third man for one.
WIDE! Graham Hume now spills it short, wide outside off. It goes past the tramline and the umpire signals a wide.
Back of a length, coming into the batter from outside off. Towhid Hridoy flicks it to square leg for a single.

Time for a Drinks break. Bangladesh has done really well with this partnership between Towhid Hridoy and Shakib Al Hasan. The have set a solid platform to launch big in the closing stage of this game. Ireland need a break through else these two are taking this away from them.

FOUR! Good-looking shot! Shakib Al Hasan is able to hunt down boundaries now quite regularly since his fifty. It is full and on off. Shakib Al Hasan stands tall and drives it aerially down the ground for four runs. No fielder has a chance to stop this one. Shakib Al Hasan had it well under control.
Full and on off. Towhid Hridoy pushes it to mid off for one.
WIDE! Harry Tector now goes full, well outside the tramline though. Towhid Hridoy lets it be and the umpire signals a wide.
A single now as this is pushed into covers.
Fuller, outside off. Towhid Hridoy gets forward and pushes it to backward point off the outer half. One taken.
Flighted, going down leg.Hridoy tickles it to short fine.
Full and on off. Shakib Al Hasan eases it to covers for a single.
A bit fuller, on fifth stump. Towhid Hridoy lets it be.
Full and on off, pushed towards mid off.
A length ball, around off. Towhid Hridoy blocks it out watchfully.
FOUR! EDGY! It is a good-length ball, in the channel. Towhid Hridoy shuffles a touch and plays it late. The ball takes the outside edge, beats the diving keeper and races away to the third man fence.
Short and on off. Shakib Al Hasan pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Shot of authority. It is a full ball, on off. Shakib Al Hasan gets under it and lofts it over the bowler's head for four runs.

It is a short one, wide of off. Towhid Hridoy rocks back and slashes hard at it. The ball zips past the outside edge. Lorcan Tucker gathers it at a good height. Towhid Hridoy keeps his back leg grounded and spins inside the crease, just casually strolling to the leg side late. Lorcan Tucker gets the bails off thinking he lifted his back leg. The square leg umpire takes it upstairs and confirms that Towhid Hridoy is safe.
Back of a length, outside off. Towhid Hridoy shuffles and dabs it out.
Tossed up, full and on off. Shakib Al Hasan lofts it over mid off. It lands safely though. They cross for one.
Back of a length, on off. Towhid Hridoy goes back and pushes it gently towards cover. One taken.
Floated and going down leg. Shakib Al Hasan tucks it to square leg and scampers across for a quick single.
Half-century on debut for Towhid Hridoy. Fuller outside off, Towhid Hridoy drives this to deep extra cover for a single.
FOUR! On a length going down leg, Towhid Hridoy flicks this in the gap for a boundary towards deep square leg.
Short-pitched delivery outside off, Shakib Al Hasan punches this to backward point for a single. Half-century for Shakib Al Hasan.
On a length outside off, Towhid Hridoy cuts this to third man for a single.
Short and wide of off, Shakib Al Hasan cuts this to third man for a single.
Back of a length around middle, Shakib Al Hasan pulls this in the gap at deep mid-wicket for a couple.
On a length around middle, Shakib Al Hasan pushes this to short mid-wicket for no run.
On a length around middle, Towhid Hridoy tucks this to the on side and finds a fielder for no run.
Short-pitched delivery head high, Towhid pulls this and collects a couple, Good work in the deep to keep it down to a couple.
Leg cutter on a length outside off, Towhid Hridoy taps this to short third for no run.
Fuller one in middle, Towhid Hridoy defends this off the front foot.
FOUR! Back of a length around hips, Towhid Hridoy tickles this off his hips for a boundary in the direction of fine leg. A welcome boundary for Bangladesh.
Short-pitched delivery in middle, Shakib Al Hasan pulls this and finds the fielder in the deep on the on side for a single.
Flighted on off, Shakib Al Hasan advances down the track and pushes this to long off for a single.
Fuller around leg, Towhid Hridoy pushes this to long on for a comfortable rotation of strike.
Short in length around middle, Shoriful Islam pushes this to long on for a single.
Tossed up on off, Shoriful Islam pushes this back to the bowler.
Quicker through the air on off, Shakib Al Hasan defends this off the front foot.
Tossed up outside off, Towhid Hridoy drives this wide of sweeper cover for a single.
Short and wide outside off, Towhid Hridoy punches this to sweeper cover for a single.
On a length around middle, Towhid Hridoy pushes this to the on side for no run.
Short-pitched delivery down leg, Shakib Al Hasan pulls this all along the ground for a single towards fine leg.
Short and wide of off, Towhid Hridoy cuts this to sweeper cover for a single.
On a length outside off, Shakib Al Hasan cuts this to wide third man for a single.
On a length on top of off, Shakib Al Hasan cuts this late but Harry Tector was quick on this and saves a single.
Tossed up outside off, Shakib Al Hasan drives this to long off for a single.
Quicker through the air going down leg, Shakib Al Hasan defends this off his pads for no run.
Tossed up on off, Shakib Al Hasan advances down the ground and drills this over the head of the non-striker for a couple.
FLighted on off, Towhid Hridoy drives this to long on for a single.
Fuller around off, Shakib Al Hasan pushes this to long on for a comfortable rotation of strike.
Tossed up on off, Towhid Hridoy pushes this to cover and takes a single.
On a length around middle, Towhid Hridoy glances this to fine leg for a single.
Wide! Third wide of the over as he darts one way short of Towhid Hridoy this time.
Wide! On a length going down leg, Towhid Hridoy looks to flick but misses out. Wide signaled.
Bouncer head high, Shakib Al Hasan pulls this flat towards fine leg for a single.
Short and wide outside off, Towhid Hridoy pushes this to sweeper cover for a single.
On a length outside off, Towhid Hridoy defends this off the front foot.
Back of a length around middle, Shakib Al Hasan pushes thie to backward point for a single.
Wide! Attempted bouncer but it climbs way too high. Wide signaled.
On a length around middle, Shakib Al Hasan looks to slog but manages to hit this one bounce to the fielder at short mid-wicket.
Short in length around off, Towhid Hridoy pushes this to short cover for no run.
Fuller one around off, Towhid Hridoy pushes this to short cover.
Fuller around off, Shakib Al Hasan drives this uppishly but in the gap for a single towards deep extra cover.
Tossed up on off, Shakib Al Hasan pushes this back to the bowler.
Fuller around middle, Towhid Hridoy pushes this wide of short mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller on off, Towhid Hridoy pushes this to short cover for no run.
Floater just outside off, Shakib Al Hasan cuts this late to cover-point and Towhid Hridoy refuses the single.
Quicker and flatter around off, Towhid Hridoy pushes this to sweeper cover for a comfortable single.
Googly pitching on off, Shakib Al Hasan punches this off the back foot to sweeper cover for a single.
Tossed up around off, Shakib Al Hasan pushes this to long off for a couple.
Half-tracker on off, Towhid Hridoy hops onto his back foot and pulls this flat but the fielder at short mid-wicket gets a hand to it so just a single taken.
Fuller around off, Shakib Al Hasan pushes this to long off for a single.
Fuller one outside off, Towhid Hridoy drives this solidly one bounce to short cover.
Back of a length outside off, Shakib Al Hasan pushes this to sweeper cover for a single.
Length dragged back a bit towards middle, Shakib Al Hasan looks to pull but gets an inside edge onto his pads for no run.
Good length delivery around middle, Towhid Hridoy clips this off his pads to fine leg for a single.
Back of a length around pads, Shakib Al Hasan pulls this to fine leg for a single.
On a length outside off, Shakib Al Hasan cuts this towards backward point and takes a couple.
Tossed up outside off, Shakib Al Hasan punches this to long off for a single.
Fuller one turning down leg, Towhid Hridoy walks down the track and flicks this off his pads for a single.
FOUR! Short in length around middle, Towhid Hridoy hops onto his back foot and pushes this past the fielder at short mid-wicket for a boundary.
Flighted on pads, Shakib Al Hasan pushes this to long on for a single.
Fuller around off, Shakib Al Hasan pushes this to mid off for nothing.
Tossed up outside off, Towhid Hridoy pushes this to long off and sets off for a single.
Floated, full and on off. Towhid Hridoy pushes it to mid on and crosses for a single as there is a misfield.

An incredible achievement for Shakib Al Hasan. It is a full ball, on off. Shakib Al Hasan pushes it gently towards mid off and crosses. That will be 7000 runs for Shakib Al Hasan in ODIs for Bangladesh.
Shorter, on off. Shakib Al Hasan dabs it to backward point.
Length ball, angled into the pads. Hridoy flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
BEATEN! On a length, outside off. It shapes away. Towhid Hridoy walks across and tries to have a poke at it but misses.
Campher dishes a full one, on off. Towhid Hridoy defends it late towards point.
A single to end the over, as this full one is flicked to mid-wicket.
Back of a length, on middle. Towhid Hridoy rocks back and carves it through cover-point. Two fielders give it a chase and keep it down to two runs.
On off, defended back to the bowler.
Flatter and on leg, Hridoy tucks it to the leg side.
Short, on off. Shakib Al Hasan bunts it towards long off for one.
Tossed up, around off. Towhid Hridoy prods and nudges it past short mid-wicket for one.
Floated and full, on off. Shakib Al Hasan sweeps this to the man behind square leg.
Flatter and on off. Shakib Al Hasan pushes it to point. There is an overthrow which allows the batter to take one more.
Full, outside off. Shakib Al Hasan drives it to covers.
Darted, on the pads, Shakib Al Hasan tucks it to the leg side.
On off, defended.
Tector spills it down the leg side. Towhid Hridoy gets some back on it. Paul Stirling saves a certain boundary as he is able to get a hand on it, at leg slip. One taken.
Harry Tector continues from this end.
Full, on leg. Towhid Hridoy tucks it to the leg side for a single this time. A successful over from McBrine comes to an end.

FOUR! Towhid Hridoy opens his account in ODI cricket with a boundary. It is darted on the pads. Towhid Hridoy uses the depth of his crease and wrists it through fine leg. The ball goes through the gap and races away to the fence.
Full and on off, blocked out solidly.

Time for Drinks. Ireland is right on top at this point as they removed the top order from the middle without many on board. Bangladesh would be looking to build a partnership here and get back in the game.

OUT! Sound of timber! Andy McBrine gets rid of the big fish here. Najmul Hossain Shanto trudges back to the pavilion. Andy McBrine continues his attack from 'round the wicket and this time get rewarded for it. It is a full ball, coming in with the arm, on off. Najmul Hossain Shanto tries to hit it through the line but leaves a huge gap between bat and pad. The ball sneaks through to rattle the stumps. Bangladesh have lost their third wicket here.
Full and on off, Najmul Hossain Shanto blocks it watchfully.
Full and on off. Shakib Al Hasan pushes it gently to covers and gets a single.
Short one, outside off. Shakib Al Hasan cuts it through the off side for one.

Woah! Shakib Al Hasan is taken aback here. Harry Tector drifts in a full one, around middle. The ball though grips and turns away a touch, although with a lot of bounce this time. Shakib Al Hasan goes back and it comes off the gloves. The ball lobs briefly but is down in no time.
Tossed up, full and on off. Shakib Al Hasan gets it down to third man off the outside edge. Two runs taken.
Shakib Al Hasan prods to this full one and defends solidly.
Short, turning away from outside off with some bounce. Najmul Hossain Shanto cuts it to sweeper cover. One taken.
Full and on off. Shanto pushes it to cover.
On off, blocked out watchfully. These two batters are managing to keep the runs ticking.
A single now as this full ball is worked to short third.
FOUR! Top placement. It is a short one, wide of off. Najmul Hossain Shanto hangs back and slaps it through covers. It disects the fielders in the deep this time.

Floated and full, outside off. Najmul Hossain Shanto gets down on one knee and tries to go for the sweep. The ball through grips and turns away sharply and Najmul Hossain Shanto is nowhere near the ball. Lorcan Tucker is quick to take the bails off but Shanto had his back leg grounded inside the crease.
A bit short, this one holds up a bit. Najmul Hossain Shanto goes back and punches it past extra cover. The sweeper cover comes across and keeps it down to two runs.
Pushed through quicker, on the stumps. Shakib Al Hasan dabs it to covers and takes off for a quick single.
Back of a length, around off. Shakib Al Hasan punches it into covers and takes a single.
Najmul Hossain Shanto cuts this short ball to sweeper cover for one.
On off, blocked out.
Looped up, on off. It grips and turns away with some extra bounce. Shakib Al Hasan helps it to point and crosses.
Flatter, on off, Shakib Al Hasan fends it away.
Short and on leg. Najmul Hossain Shanto knocks it down to long on for a single.
Harry Tector comes into the attack.
Floated and full, outside off. Najmul Hossain Shanto gets under it and lofts it towards long off. The ball though meets the fielder on a bounce. A good over for Bangladesh, 7 runs come off it.
Great fielding! Slightly short, outside off. Najmul Hossain Shanto cuts it hard into covers off his back foot. The fielder there dives to his right and save a certain boundary.
A single now as Shakib Al Hasan pushes it down to long on.
FOUR! Shakib Al Hasan finds the gap this time. Andy McBrine goes short again, outside off. Shakib Al Hasan waits for it and cuts it in front of point. The ball races away to the fence.
On off, blocked out.
Short and on off. Najmul Hossain Shanto dabs it to backward point and crosses for a quick run.
It is full, sliding down leg. Shakib Al Hasan tickles it down to fine leg and collects a brace.

IN THE AIR...SAFE! Curtis Campher bends his back hard and digs in a short ball, on middle. Shakib Al Hasan thinks about riding the bounce and goes for a wild heave across the line. He does not middle it. The ball lobs towards mid on, but falls short of the fielder there. Shakib Al Hasan living dangerously here.
Length, on off, pushed out to safety.
FOUR! Smacked! This should release some pressure. Back of a length, outside off. Shakib Al Hasan rocks back,frees his arm and cuts it powerfully through the gap at covers for four runs.
Curtis Campher hurls in a length ball, around middle and leg, it nips back in to catch the front pad of Shakib Al Hasan. There is an appeal for lbw but the umpire is unmoved.
Fraction short, on top of off. Shakib Al Hasan hangs back and dabs it to the off side.
Around off, Najmul Hossain Shanto defends eases it out.
A single now as this is played down the park to long on.
On off, driven into covers.

EDGED but safe! Tossed up, outside off. It grips and turns away. Shakib Al Hasan tries to play away from his body but only catches the outside edge. The ball is in the air briefly as it goes towards point. Lands safely in the end.
Full, coming in with the arm once again. Shakib Al Hasan this time defends it on his front foot.
McBrine comes 'round the wicket and angles it in, full and on leg. Shakib Al Hasan gets beaten on the inside edge as he looks to defend it. He gets pinged on his pads, but going down leg.
Powerplay 1 comes to an end! Now, 4 fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle.
On a length outside off, Najmul Hossain Shanto defends this on the off side to end this over.
Fuller one on off, Najmul Hossain Shanto defends this back to the bowler.
Short pitched delivery around pads, Shakib Al Hasan tucks this to square leg and takes a single.
The veteran Shakib Al Hasan walks in at number 4. Can he get his side out of trouble here. Two early blows certainly have put the hosts on the back foot here.

OUT! Change of pace does the trick for Ireland. On a length much slower this time, Litton Das gets early into his stroke ad lofts this into the hands of Paul Stirling at short cover. Change of bowling works for Ireland.
Commentary.Howout: c Paul Stirling b Curtis Campher

Commentary.Commentary: On a length outside off, Litton Das pushes this to point for no run.
FOUR! Beautifully struck for four. Overpitched on pads, Litton Das glances this and finds the gap at mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Change. Curtis Campher now is being introduced into the attack. Will he be able to find the breakthrough?
Fuller around middle, Litton Das pushes this to long on for a single.
Full and wide outside off, Najmul Hossain Shanto drives this to sweeper cover for a single.
Tossed up around middle, Litton Das flicks this to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Short in length around middle, Litton Das pushes this to short mid-wicket.
Quicker and flatter on off, Najmul Hossain Shanto hits this from the inside of his bat towards mid on and they take a single.
Tossed up outside off, Litton Das drives this to long off for a single.
Fuller and on off, Najmul Hossain Shanto defends this back to the bowler.
On a length around pads, Litton Das pushes this with soft hands to short mid-wicket and takes a quick single.
Short and just outside off, Najmul Hossain Shanto cuts this to backward point for a single.
On a length just outside off, Najmul Hossain Shanto looked uncertain about what to do with this. Gets lucky that it beats his outside edge.
Short-pitched delivery outside off, Najmul Hossain Shanto drags this from outside off and pulls this to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Short and wide of off, Litton Das stands tall and cuts this to third man for a single.
Fuller one on off, Litton Das works this to deep square leg for a single.
Short in length outside off, Najmul Hossain Shanto cuts this but Curtis Campher at extra cover does well to dive and save a certain boundary. Single taken though.
Tossed up outside off, Najmul Hossain Shanto defends this off the front foot.
Fuller on off, Litton Das flicks this to deep square leg for a single.
Tossed up and turning in, Litton Das works this on the on side for no run.
Off-break outside off, Litton Das tucks this to short mid-wicket.
Change. Andy McBrine comes into the attack now.
On a length outside off, Najmul Hossain Shanto leaves this.

Litton Das gets fortunate here as this could have gone straight to point. Fuller one outside off, Litton Das goes searching and gets a leading edge that flies just over the point fielder for a single.
Short and wide outside off, Litton Das cuts this to point.
Full and wide outside off, Litton Das takes a stride forward and leaves this for the keeper to collect.
Length dragged back a bit, Litton Das taps this to point.
Back of a length around middle, Litton Das defends this textbook style back to the bowler.
Short-pitched delivery head high, Litton Das rolls his wrists and plays this down to deep square leg for a single.
Touch fuller around off, Litton Das pushes this to point.
Back of a length outside off, Litton Das guides this to point.
Back of a length around middle, Litton Das pushes this to short mid-wicket.
Wide! Banged in by Mark Adair down leg, Litton Das looks to pull but misses out. Wide signaled.
SIX! High and handsome from Litton Das. Short-pitched delivery body bound, Litton Das leans back a bit and upper cuts this for a maximum just above the third man fielder on the fence.
On a length outside off, Litton Das gets behind this and rolls it to cover.
Fuller delivery on off, Najmul Hossain Shanto pushes this to the off side for no run.
On alength around middle, Najmul Hossain Shanto defends this out.
Good length delivery on off, Najmul Hossain Shanto defends this to short mid-wicket.
Fuller one around pads, Najmul Hossain Shanto flicks this wide of deep square leg for a couple.
On alength around pads, Najmul Hossain Shanto places this to the vacant deep square leg and takes a couple.
Fuller on around off, Najmul Hossain Shanto blocks this out.
On a length on top of off, Litton Das defends this of the back foot for no run.
Too full around off, Najmul Hossain Shanto pushes this wide of cover and they run 3 for this. Good effort in the field to save 1 run for the team.
Fuller outside off, Najmul Hossain Shanto leaves this for the keeper to collect.
Wide! On a length angling away from the batter. This was way too wide and Najmul Hossain Shanto leaves this. Wide signaled by the umpire.
Najmul Hossain Shanto comes in at number 3.

OUT! TAKEN AT FIRST SLIP! Bangladesh lose an early wicket and the crowd has gone completely silent here. Fuller one outside off, Tamim Iqbal chases this and gets an outside edge that flies to Paul Stirling at first slip. Sterling makes no mistake and accepts this gift from Tamim to dismiss him. Mark Adair makes an instant impact here. Can Ireland build on this early wicket?
Commentary.Howout: c Paul Stirling b Mark Adair

Commentary.Commentary: Full and wide outside off, Tamim Iqbal lets this go to the keeper. A hint of movement here.
Full and wide outside off, Tamim mishits this in front of square on the on side for no run.
FOUR! A bit short, outside off. Litton Das rocks back and slashes it hard through covers. It races away to the fence.
Fuller around pads, Tamim guides this off his hips to fine leg for a single.
On a length outside off, Tamim leaves this for the keeper to collect.
Fuller delivery down leg, Litton works this to fine leg for a single.
On a length around pads, Tamim flicks this to square leg and takes a single.
Full, on the pads, Das clips it to the leg side for one.
Graham Hume to start with the second new ball from the other end.
Fuller and on middle, Tamim Iqbal tucks this to square leg for nothing to end the first over.
Full and wide outside off, Litton Das drives this and the fielder at cover-point spills this as they take a single.
Good length delivery outside off, Litton Das presents full face of his bat as he defends this too.
On a length on top of off, Litton Das defends this on the off side for no run.
Back of a length around pads, Tamim Iqbal tucks this to square leg for a single. First runs off the bat.
5 Wides! Fuller one wide down leg, Tamim Iqbal looks to flick but misses out and the keeper misses this too. Five wides.
On a length outside off, Tamim Iqbal looks to poke but leaves it right at the end.

The match is set to begin. Ireland players make their way out on the field. Followed by Tamim Iqbal and Litton Das who walk out to open for Bangladesh. It will be Mark Adair to start with the first new ball.

Tamim Iqbal, the captain of Bangladesh, is in for a chat. He says that he does not mind batting first. The wicket looks good with some grass on it. Adds that the dressing room is really happy with the momentum on their side. Mentions that it is all about getting off to a solid start with the blade.

Andy Balbirnie, the Irish skipper is in for a chat. He says they will bowl first as the wicket looks really good and later there will be dew as well. He adds that the venue is really good as he has been part of the BPL recently and knows that these the track here stays true.

Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Tamim Iqbal (C), Litton Das, Najmul Hossain Shanto, Mushfiqur Rahim (WK), Shakib Al Hasan, Towhid Hridoy (On ODI debut), Yasir Ali, Taskin Ahmed, Mustafizur Rahman, Ebadot Hossain, Nasum Ahmed.
Ireland (Playing XI) - Paul Stirling, Stephen Doheny, Andy Balbirnie (C), Harry Tector, George Dockrell, Curtis Campher, Lorcan Tucker (WK), Gareth Delany, Andy McBrine, Mark Adair, Graham Hume.
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of Ireland. They will BOWL first.

Ireland, on the other hand, will be happy as they are a team on up at the moment. The progress of the squad has been impressive and the fearless brand of cricket that they play is something every team in the world is keeping a keen eye on. Andy Balbirnie leads this Ireland squad which has a perfect blend of experience and youth and the team is filled with two and three-dimensional players from top to bottom. A lot would depend on Paul Stirling and the skipper himself as they are the experienced heads of this squad. These two players need to focus on building stands in the middle, which can harm the opposition. The battle between these two giant killers will be one to watch for. Toss and team news coming up shortly...

Bangladesh is currently on a real high after imposing a whitewash on England in the T20I series which was recently concluded. Though they lost the ODI series by 1-2, they will be taking a lot of positives with them into this game. Tamim Iqbal leads the Bangladesh side, who has a mixture of youngsters and seniors players at his dispoal. Mahmudullah though has been rested for the first two ODIs. So expect some new combinations and strategies from the home side.

Hello and welcome to all! It is now time for the first of the 3-match ODI series between Bangladesh and Ireland which will take place at the Sylhet International Cricket Stadium. Bangladesh are a lethal force at home and Ireland need to bring their A-game here, if they are to beat the mighty Bangla Tigers.
... MATCH DAY ...

As we head closer to the 2023 World Cup, the teams are utilizing this crucial time to be prepared for the main event and hence expect a lot of ODI action in the coming months across the cricketing world. Now, we shift our attention to a new assignment in which, Ireland are travelling down to Bangladesh for a multi-format series. They will kick things off with a 3-match ODI series, followed by the shortest format, wherein three matches will be played as well and the tour will end with a one-off Test match between the two sides. Bangladesh will be brimming with confidence as they are coming into this series after completing a whitewash against England, that too, on home turf. Although, Bangladesh could not get over the line in the ODI series as they lost 2-1. Nevertheless, they are a formidable side whenever playing at home. All the visiting teams, find it as a stern test to come out victorious in Bangladesh. This time Mahmudullah has been rested for the first two ODIs, this will allow the hosts to open the door for their youngsters, work on different combinations and strategies to prepare themselves for the upcoming World Cup. It will be Tamim Iqbal leading the side. Shakib Al Hasan and Mushfiqur Rahim are the two senior minds at his disposal. Litton Das and Najmul Hossain Shanto will be crucial with the blade up top. Taskin Ahmed and Mustafizur Rahman will be leading the seam attack, while Mehidy Hasan and Nasum Ahmed will be in charge of the spin attack. Ireland, on the other hand, would feel that they are on the right path here as far as growth is concerned but now, they will also need some results to back up their progress. It will be Andy Balbirnie who will be captaining the side. He has some incredible players at his disposal, namely Paul Stirling, Harry Tector and Lorcan Tucker, who can take the game away from the opposition with the bat in hand. Mark Adair will be leading the bowling attack for them along with Andy McBrine, and Barry McCarthy. Both teams have a point to prove here and it surely promises to be a cracking encounter. Who will take an early lead in this series? We shall find out together.
